properties.description: Game Mode. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFF600 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xF600. Expected canonical meaning: game.mode. Unknown values are preserved numerically. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Paused. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFF63A converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xF63A. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Expected canonical meaning: game.paused. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Zone. Sonic 1 stores this as a zero-based zone index: raw 0 is Zone 1 / Green Hill Zone, raw 1 is Zone 2 / Labyrinth Zone, raw 2 is Zone 3 / Marble Zone, raw 3 is Zone 4 / Star Light Zone, raw 4 is Zone 5 / Spring Yard Zone and raw 5 is Zone 6 / Scrap Brain Zone. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE10 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE10. Closest expected canonical meaning: game.level.

Act. Sonic 1 stores this as a zero-based act index: raw 0 is Act 1, raw 1 is Act 2, and raw 2 is Act 3. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE11 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE11. Expected canonical meaning where supported: game.stage.
Boss Status. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFF7A7 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xF7A7. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Giant Ring Collected. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFF7CD converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xF7CD. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Lives. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE12 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE12. Expected canonical meaning: player.1.lives. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Rings. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE20 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE20. RetroArch READ_CORE_RAM for this Mega Drive mapping returns 16-bit RAM pairs byte-swapped, represented by byte_order=swap16; after block normalisation this decodes as a big-endian word. Expected ordinary range 0-999; raw value is not clamped. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Score. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE26 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE26. Sonic stores score internally in 10-point units, so EDAS scales the raw value by 10 to match the in-game HUD score. Expected canonical meaning: player.1.score. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Continues. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE18 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE18. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Chaos Emeralds. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE57 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE57. Expected ordinary range 0-6; raw value is not clamped. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Shield. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE2C converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE2C. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Invincibility. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE2D converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE2D. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Speed Shoes. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE2E converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE2E. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Underwater Air. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE14 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE14. Do not assume this is directly measured in seconds until runtime-verified. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
properties.notes: Only meaningful while Sonic is underwater; the displayed unit needs runtime confirmation.

properties.description: Time Over. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE1A converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE1A. Zero decodes false; any non-zero value decodes true. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Last Checkpoint. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE30 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE30. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
properties.notes: Zero may mean that no checkpoint has been activated in the current act.

properties.description: Level Time Minutes. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE23 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE23. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Level Time Seconds. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE24 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE24. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.

Level Time Subseconds. Sonic 1 RAM variable at $FFFFFE25 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xFE25. This is the game's internal sub-second/centisecond field; exact real-time precision still needs runtime verification.
properties.notes: Sub-second field; do not assume a real-time unit until verified against the HUD.

properties.description: Sonic X Position. Sonic/player object RAM at $FFFFD008 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xD008. Expected canonical meaning where supported: player.1.position.x. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Sonic Y Position. Sonic/player object RAM at $FFFFD00C converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xD00C. Expected canonical meaning where supported: player.1.position.y. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
Sonic X Velocity. Sonic/player object RAM at $FFFFD010 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xD010. Expected canonical meaning where supported: player.1.velocity.x. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
properties.notes: Signed movement value; negative values indicate leftward movement.

properties.description: Sonic Y Velocity. Sonic/player object RAM at $FFFFD012 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xD012. Expected canonical meaning where supported: player.1.velocity.y. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
properties.notes: Signed movement value; sign orientation needs runtime confirmation.

properties.description: Sonic Inertia. Sonic/player object RAM at $FFFFD014 converted to READ_CORE_RAM offset 0xD014. Needs runtime validation in EDAS.
properties.notes: Signed ground-speed/inertia value; it can differ from instantaneous X velocity while Sonic is on a slope.

provenance.notes: Sonic the Hedgehog for Sega Genesis/Mega Drive. ROM revision: Revision 0, USA/Europe/Japan. Identifier: CRC32 F9394E97; hash algorithm: crc32. Sources: Sonic 1 disassembly RAM variable definitions; Sonic 1 disassembly object-structure constants; GameHacking.org CRC identification. Full Mega Drive hardware RAM addresses are based at $FFFF0000 and were converted to RetroArch READ_CORE_RAM 64 KB offsets by subtracting $FFFF0000. Example: $FFFFFE20 becomes 0xFE20. This profile is draft/needs runtime validation: fields are address-sourced but have not yet been observed changing correctly through EDAS. Core mapping: generic Mega Drive READ_CORE_RAM profile using byte_order=swap16 because live testing showed 16-bit RAM pairs returned byte-swapped, e.g. rings 102 appeared as response bytes 66 00 before block normalisation. Score is scaled by 10 because Sonic 1 stores score internally in 10-point units.
